name: Ancient Wolf Den
description: A massive, shadowed cavern carved into the northern frost cliffs. Ice mist swirls around gold-accented pillars, and a faint blue crystal glow reveals the gnawed remains of legendary beasts.
environment: Giant cave entrance with frost and stone archways, crumbling royal blue ruins, gold banner trims, and freezing wolf mist.

name: Great Bear Cavern
description: An immense underground dome filled with honey-colored volcanic crystals and royal marble arches. Geothermal steam rises from deep chasms, warming the gold-veined cavern walls.
environment: Titanic earth cave framed by broken temple steps, rich gold-flecked quartz blocks, sapphire runestones, and thick heated steam.

name: Crystal Spider Nest
description: A hauntingly beautiful cavern system draped in glowing spun silk. Shimmering sapphire stalactites pulse with a rhythmic, alien purple magic, reflecting off discarded runic armor plates.
environment: Deep violet-hued tunnel entrance choked with cobwebs, luminescent blue mineral columns, and hovering magical spores.

name: Stone Troll Stronghold
description: A brutalist rock fortress built into the roots of the world. Crude iron fortifications mesh with classical gold-trimmed columns, creating a dark, defensible bastion.
environment: Craggy, imposing mountain gorge leading to a heavy steel-reinforced gateway. Overgrown with glowing moss and guarded by sentinel totems.

name: Ancient Dragon Cavern
description: The ultimate seat of fire and stone. Colossal marble pillars melted by historic breaths support a towering dome where lava rivers feed glowing crystal pools of pure magical essence.
environment: A breathtaking, giant volcanic chasm decorated with gold relic statues, towering sapphire geodes, and drifting ash embers.
